name: COMPUGT
recent: COMPUGT 近期没有重要公告或新闻，只有董事与主要股东在9月下旬的持股变动申报，以及10月22日多名董事与高层在第三季业绩公布前的闭市期交易意向通知。
notable: 执行董事 See Thoo Chan 于9月29日以每股 RM0.015 增持 9,030,000 股。
非执行董事 Tan Siew Li 于9月29日以每股 RM0.015 减持 12,846,900 股。
董事与高层在第三季业绩公布前发出闭市期交易意向通知。
risks: 非执行董事 Tan Siew Li 在9月29日减持 12,846,900 股。
多名董事与高层在第三季业绩公布前通知可能在闭市期交易。

recent_en: COMPUGT has no major announcements or news recently, only filings of changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests in late September and notices of intention to deal during the closed period ahead of the third quarter results on 22 October.
notable_en: Executive Director See Thoo Chan acquired 9,030,000 shares at RM0.015 per share on 29 September.
Non-Executive Director Tan Siew Li disposed of 12,846,900 shares at RM0.015 per share on 29 September.
Directors and a senior officer gave notices of intention to deal during the closed period ahead of the third quarter results.
risks_en: Non-Executive Director Tan Siew Li disposed of 12,846,900 shares on 29 September.
Several directors and a senior officer notified possible dealings during the closed period before the third quarter results.
